_doc: BAROQUE_BIOMES_COMPOSE_1 — the single source of truth for what 'RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes' (mandrake.rm.biomes) contains.
Spec: design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_unification_spec.md (§2 packaging, §3 assemblies, §5 settings, §6 waves, §8 rulings).
Built by: python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/deploy_custom_mods.py --compose biomes   (plan only; add --apply to write).
Collision sweeps (re-run before every load-prove): python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/biomes_compose_sweeps.py
Each entry's source folder stays where it is under src/RimMandrake/ (Q6: compose, never physically merge).
An entry is COMPOSED (shipped inside the unified mod, and refused as a standalone deploy target) when its 'wave' <= 'compose_wave'.
'entries' ORDER IS THE LoadFolders.xml ORDER, after the root '/'. Engines first (spec §3: their static ctors run first), biomes alphabetical by key, sea/sand kits last (spec §2).

MEASURED from decompiled 1.6 (ModContentPack.InitLoadFolders + DirectXmlLoader.XmlAssetsInModFolder): Defs/ and Patches/ are read in REVERSE LoadFolders order, and a relative path already seen in a later-listed root SHADOWS the same relative path in an earlier one (TryAdd). Assemblies/ load in LoadFolders order, deduped by relative path. So every shipped relative path must be unique across entries — the compose verb refuses otherwise.

wave 2 = everything currently on the owner's live ModsConfig (measured 2026-09-27 from the live file, not the spec's snapshot): the spec's on-list 12, plus BlueDesert, CreatureBehaviors, EnvironmentalHazards, LanternDeeps and MovingDunes, which are ALL active on the live list. Folding any of them before the wave-2 swap would put its defs and types in the game twice.

about.name: RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes
about.author: Mandrake
about.description: Every RimMandrake biome in one mod, each with its own on/off toggle in Mod Settings. A toggle stops that biome being placed on NEW worlds and (as each biome is wired to it) stops its behaviour; it never unloads defs, so existing maps and saves keep their terrain and creatures. Built by composing the per-biome RimMandrake mods; see the Mod Settings page for the roster.

entries.label: Creature Behaviors
entries.blurb: Shared creature-AI engine (hunting, lairs, swarms) that many biomes' fauna ride on.

entries.label: Environmental Hazards
entries.blurb: Shared hazard engine: configurable terrain, gas and weather mechanics used across biomes.
